description.en: RVC is an offline retrieval-based voice conversion family packaged for audio.cpp with native HuBERT content features, RMVPE pitch extraction, optional IVF retrieval blending, packaged v1/v2 voices, and support for user-supplied RVC checkpoints.
description.zh: RVC 是面向 audio.cpp 打包的离线检索式音色转换家族，含原生 HuBERT 内容特征、RMVPE 音高提取、可选 IVF 检索混合、打包的 v1/v2 音色，并支持用户自备 RVC 检查点。

voice_id.en: Packaged RVC voice id; default selects the v2 default voice. Ignored when voice_model_path is provided.
voice_id.zh: 打包的 RVC 音色 id；默认选择 v2 默认音色。提供 voice_model_path 时忽略。

voice_model_path.en: Optional user RVC .pth or .pt voice checkpoint path. When set, this overrides the packaged voice id.
voice_model_path.zh: 可选的用户 RVC .pth/.pt 音色检查点路径。设置后会覆盖打包音色 id。

pitch_extractor.en: Pitch extraction method for F0-enabled voices; the native path currently supports rmvpe only.
pitch_extractor.zh: 启用 F0 的音色所用的音高提取方法；原生路径目前仅支持 rmvpe。

semitone_shift.en: Semitone pitch shift applied before synthesis; default 0.
semitone_shift.zh: 合成前施加的半音移调；默认 0。

pitch_filter_radius.en: Pitch median-filter switch: values >2 enable a radius-1 filter; values <=2 disable it.
pitch_filter_radius.zh: 音调中值滤波器开关：值 >2 启用半径 1 滤波器；值 <=2 禁用它。

output_sample_rate.en: Output sample rate in Hz; default 0 keeps the selected voice model sample rate. Nonpositive values preserve the voice sample rate.
output_sample_rate.zh: 输出采样率（以 Hz 为单位）；默认 0 保持所选语音模型采样率。非正值保留语音采样率。

rms_mix_rate.en: RMS envelope mix rate applied after conversion; default 0.25.
rms_mix_rate.zh: 转换后施加的 RMS 包络混合比例；默认 0.25。

unvoiced_protection.en: Unvoiced consonant protection strength; must be in [0, 1], default 0.33.
unvoiced_protection.zh: 清辅音保护强度，取值 [0, 1]，默认 0.33。

speaker_id.en: Speaker embedding id for multi-speaker RVC checkpoints; default 0.
speaker_id.zh: 多说话人 RVC 检查点的说话人嵌入 id；默认 0。

audio_pad_duration_sec.en: Long-audio chunk pad duration in seconds; default 1.
audio_pad_duration_sec.zh: 长音频分块的补边时长（秒）；默认 1。

split_query_sec.en: Quiet-point query window in seconds for long-audio splitting; default 5.
split_query_sec.zh: 长音频切分时静音点的查询窗口（秒）；默认 5。

split_center_sec.en: Long-audio split center stride in seconds; default 30.
split_center_sec.zh: 长音频切分中心步长（秒）；默认 30。

split_threshold_sec.en: Input duration in seconds before quiet-point splitting is used; default 32.
split_threshold_sec.zh: 启用静音点切分前的输入时长阈值（秒）；默认 32。

pitch_file.en: Optional CSV F0 override file with time,Hz rows sorted by time.
pitch_file.zh: 可选的 CSV F0 覆盖文件，包含按时间排序的 time,Hz 行。

retrieval_index_file.en: Optional user FAISS .index retrieval path used when retrieval_blend is greater than 0 for a user voice model.
retrieval_index_file.zh: 用于用户音色模型的可选 FAISS .index 检索路径，在 retrieval_blend>0 时使用。

retrieval_blend.en: IVF retrieval feature blend rate; default 0 disables retrieval blending.
retrieval_blend.zh: IVF 检索特征混合比例；默认 0 关闭检索混合。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

licenses.name: MIT
licenses.notes: The base models (HuBERT, RMVPE) are MIT. The packaged voices (`manthos`, `chocola`, `fraise`) have no documented source or license.
